title: LED troffer, classrooms
summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: We need to know the lights will last long enough to avoid frequent replacements in classrooms.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

highlights.quote: WARRANTY — 5-year limited warranty. This is the only warranty provided and no other statements in this specification sheet create any warranty of any kind. All other express and implied warranties are disclaimed. Complete warranty terms located at: www.acuitybrands.com/support/warranty/terms-and-conditions

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: DLC listing helps ensure energy efficiency and may be required for rebates or compliance.

findings.title: macadam steps
findings.detail: Package states 3; spec requires at most 3.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Dims down to
findings.detail: Continuous dimming from 100 to 5 percent without flicker.
findings.why_it_matters: Smooth, deep dimming is important for classroom lighting flexibility and visual comfort.

findings.title: Different revision found; no quoted values changed
findings.detail: Submitted Rev. 07/18/24, web source Rev. 08/14/25. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: Just because the revision dates are different doesn’t mean one is newer—we need actual content comparison to know if anything changed.

args.status_quote: Based on recent product updates showing BLT expansions and new features (Adjustable Lumens, Switchable CCT, Tunable White, New Ribbed Reflector), the BLT series remains actively marketed and sold.
args.note: Found the manufacturer's data sheet for the 2BLT4/Lithonia BLT 2x4 product. The document shows revision "Rev. 08/14/25". Regarding the unconfirmed properties: the document mentions "Color Variation within 3-step MacAdam ellipse (3SDCM)" which relates to macadam_steps, but does not provide specific values for standards or warranty_years. The product appears to be currently active based on recent product update blogs showing ongoing BLT series enhancements.
